capabilities: Style Canvas boards with vintage light and dark paper backgrounds
Render handwritten edge labels and ink-like connection paths
Make transparent containers and alpha-contour shadows for image nodes
Install a vault-scoped generator Skill for torn-note PNG production
Hand off generation prompts to AI agents
disambiguation: Not a sticky-note creation tool on its own; styling is offline, and generating torn-note PNGs requires the bundled vault Skill plus an external AI agent.
extras: Full torn-note generation is desktop-only and requires Python 3.9+ and Pillow; appearance features work fully offline and need no AI integration. Supports English and Simplified Chinese. Requires Obsidian 1.13.0+.
intentEvidence: gives Canvas boards a restrained vintage-academia surface: warm paper backgrounds, handwritten edge labels
problem: Obsidian Canvas boards have a fixed modern look, with no way to give individual boards a vintage paper aesthetic or display torn-edge sticky-note images without white rectangles.

relations.evidence: Optional handoff to Claudian (realclaudian) or Claudian Plus, plus a portable prompt
Claudian Plus: its direct handoff API remains supported for existing users.

requires.name: AI agent (Claudian, Claudian Plus, Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi, or another file-capable agent)

summary: Canvas styling plugin that gives boards vintage paper backgrounds, handwritten edge labels, ink-like paths, and transparent torn-note PNG rendering.
